Lovely and attentive lady receptionist listened and acted with due care.  She directed me to another surgery, booked my appointment, send me location. I was seen by a doctor one hour later, got my prescription, was told where to go to get meds at that late hour. Everyone - reception team at Park Way surgery, reception team at Farley Road surgery, doctor at Farley Road surgery - were amazing.  And that's not a word I use often in same sentence as "NHS", sadly.
I called next day to thank the reception team.
